economic_hypothesis: A broad market with positive 20-session median return and at least 70% positive 20-session breadth supplies a demand floor, while a PIT industry whose 60-session median return is positive and whose 20-session return and breadth accelerate sharply over five completed sessions identifies fresh sector capital diffusion. The first moderate, volume-confirmed stock close through its prior 20-session pressure ceiling is then a short-horizon transmission event rather than a mature market-wide ceiling relay.
independence: No collapse gap, gap repair, quiet-platform identity, prior-120-session ceiling, noncrowded-industry rank, or V24/V26 source event is used.

bull_definition.broad_demand_floor: completed PIT market median ret20 > 0 and positive-ret20 breadth >= 70%
bull_definition.industry_ignition: industry median ret20 > 3%, industry positive-ret20 breadth > 60%, five-session ret20 increase >= 3 percentage points, and five-session breadth increase >= 15 percentage points

stock_event.positive_non_euphoric_leader: stock ret60 in [0%,30%] with zero prior-20-session limit-up closes
stock_event.first_pressure_break: completed close exceeds prior completed 20-session high; signal return in [2%,8%]; close location >=70%; turnover in [1.2x,4.0x] prior20 mean
stock_event.same_symbol_cooldown: more than 20 market sessions after the prior accepted identity

entry: first legal daily open strictly after decision, within three exchange sessions
